name: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B
purpose: Fastest image model of the vendor: text-to-image and image editing in one compact model for interactive workflows, local development and edge deployment on consumer hardware.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Apache License 2.0 text read in LICENSE.md of black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-4B. The 9B klein is under the FLUX Non-Commercial License v2.1 (text read in a mirror): licence limited to non-commercial purposes, outputs may be used commercially, outputs may not train competing models.

architecture.why_this_design: Unifies generation and editing in one small checkpoint for real-time generation without quality loss (vendor wording).

variants.notes: Q2_K 1.83, Q3_K_M 2.12, Q5_K_M 3.07, Q6_K 3.41, Q8_0 4.3, BF16 7.75 GB; text encoder and VAE are separate files
9B (non-commercial licence): Q2_K 3.4, Q5_K_M 7.02, Q8_0 10.25, BF16 18.16 GB

pc-12gb.notes: GGUF; BF16 needs about 13 GB per card

pc-16gb.notes: BF16 about 13 GB per card; beside the coder only after VRAM is released No seconds-per-image figure for RDNA3 or RDNA4 (or any AMD card) for this model found in web searches on 2026-11-19.

engine_support.notes: Tona has no image path; plan in research/52 is stable-diffusion.cpp as a separate backend (one model at a time). No seconds-per-image was measured on gfx1200 yet.

benchmarks.name: Seconds per image, distilled 4B, 4 steps
benchmarks.variant: RTX 5090, per the ComfyUI documentation (not a consumer mid-range card)

benchmarks.name: Seconds per image, distilled 9B, 4 steps
benchmarks.variant: GB10 (DGX Spark class, not a consumer GPU), 1024x1024

strengths: editing and multi-reference editing in the same checkpoint
weaknesses: card: rendered text may be inaccurate or distorted; prompt-following depends on prompting style
best_for: fast local generation and simple edits
soft.maturity: Black Forest Labs: established vendor (FLUX.1 family), large community (87 adapters, 81 quants on the Hub at read time).

user_reports.summary: RDNA4 reference, not klein: a Radeon RX 9070 XT user measured FLUX.2 (variant not stated) at 4.24 s/it with fp8 at 1440x810 (2026-01-05) and 2.9 s/it after system updates (2026-02-12); first runs took minutes to hours while kernels were tuned. A klein-specific AMD number was not found.

Hands-on comparisons (secondary): FLUX.2 klein 4B has stronger prompt adherence, Z-Image Turbo edges it on photorealism per step; a Chinese test found the 9B weaker than Z-Image on realism and Chinese text.

tona_fit.reason: Apache-2.0 verified, 4B, generation and editing in one checkpoint, ~2.6 GB at Q4_K_M; alternate to Z-Image Turbo for the 16 GB class and first choice where editing is wanted.
